_meta.title: Product-intent confirmation record — one row per submitted link (session ded63349, 2026-11-17)
_meta.rule: The brief specifies per submitted link: the intended ASIN, the official listing URL, the confirmation date and the source, with observed redirect targets kept in a separate field. The two field groups are never merged: a redirect is an observation anyone can reproduce; intent is a statement only the account owner can make, so intended_asin stays null until the owner supplies it (question Q2, finding I2-F-04). No value in this record is inferred; blanks are recorded as nulls with a reason.
